Transcript:
You may have heard the expression “knowledge is power.” Well – today – we’re going to give you more power to control your diet and lifestyle – by giving you the facts. Welcome to the Nutrition Facts podcast. I’m your host – Dr. Michael Greger.
Today, we have a special edition of Nutrition Facts Q and A – where I answer a wide variety of your questions on You Tube – on a cornucopia of topics. On what subjects you may ask? For starters…we look at how to get rid of the circles under our eyes, the healthiest type of whole grain breads, and I share a fabulous recipe for purple sweet potato fries. Enjoy.
